Great Experience. Mostly.
Desoxymethyltestosterone (DMT) is an oral anabolic steroid which [in 2009] is not regulated by the FDA. It is currently uncategorized and can be purchased over the counter.
Short story is I took 45mg a day for 6 weeks. It was fucking fantastic, best drug I've ever used. I gained fifteen pounds of muscle and got 8 pack abs.  Bench press went up 50 pounds and I added ten pounds to single arm curls. I was never sore even after a brutal leg workout. I looked the best I ever had in my life I was getting laid constantly.
And the muscles were the least impressive effect. I felt awesome it was subtle and hard to describe but it was the happiest I've ever been. Life was intoxicating. I felt simultaneously completely switched on and zen at the same time. Music was better. Sex was much better. Everything was more -soulful-.
Then I started pct (post cycle therapy) using Clomid, big mistake. Clomid gave me severe anxiety and a limp noodle. If it weren't for my experiences with bad trips and shitty comedowns I probably would have lost it.
If it weren't for my experiences with bad trips and shitty comedowns I probably would have lost it.
I lost most of the weight I gained because I stopped working out and had a shitty pct.
I was very surprised how great I felt while I was on them it seemed almost like the perfect drug and the good feeling built the longer I took it (didnt really notice for the first few days).
I felt sharp strong witty and magical.
Will definitely cycle again.
